title: Crucifixion
summary: Crucifixion was a Roman method of execution associated with shame, suffering, public warning, and imperial power.
background: The Gospel accounts present the crucifixion not merely as Roman punishment but as the appointed means by which Christ bore sin, fulfilled Scripture, and accomplished redemption.
teachingHelp: Do not dwell on gore for its own sake. Show the shame, substitution, fulfillment, and victory of Christ’s cross.
sources: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
